'''Players' Choice Sealed Deck''' is a Star Wars CCG sealed-deck format. [[Decipher]] ran it as a side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] for Star Wars CCG and ''Star Trek'' CCG. Decipher's own description of the event is not preserved.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Type:''' sealed deck
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (1999)
* '''Card pool:''' sealed product chosen for the event (Decipher's description is not preserved)
* '''In use:''' 1999 (DecipherCon 1999)
* '''Also called:''' Players Choice (Decipher's score sheet)
* '''GEMP:''' none

== History ==
DecipherCon 1999 scheduled Star Wars Players' Choice Sealed Deck (event SW.21) on Thursday 11 November from 10 p.m. to 4 a.m.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref> Further heats ran Friday 12 November from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. and Saturday 13 November from 9 p.m. to 3 a.m.<ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref> A score sheet survives for the Saturday heat. Results are on [[DecipherCon 1999 Players Choice]].

The ''Star Trek'' CCG schedule listed its own Players' Choice Sealed Deck (ST.21) on Thursday and Saturday.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
